# Marilla Cuthbert

## Overview

- **Age:** Eighty-five years old  <sub>[v5 c2 P6](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0006)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v5 c2 P6](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0006)</sub>
- **Origin:** Green Gables  <sub>[v2 c17 P73](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0073), [v4 c2 P1](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0001)</sub>
- **Role:** Housekeeper and homemaker  <sub>[v1 c6 P34](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0034), [v4 c4 P8](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0008)</sub>
- **Titles:** Miss Cuthbert  <sub>[v2 c1 P16](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0016), [v4 c19 P0](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0000), [v5 c2 P5](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0005)</sub>; Aunt Marilla  <sub>[v5 c3 P6](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0006)</sub>

## Appearance

Marilla was originally described as a tall, thin, angular woman without curves, with dark hair showing gray streaks tightly pinned in a hard little knot behind. Over the years she grew somewhat thinner, more angular, and gaunt, with her hair eventually turning snow-white. Although she suffered from failing eyesight around sixty, her vision strangely improved as she reached old age.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v1 c33 P15](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0015), [v3 c22 P2](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0002), [v5 c2 P6](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0006)_

## Personality

Marilla possesses a rigid conscience, a sensible disposition, and a practical, no-nonsense approach to life. Though outwardly stern, strict, and prone to dry sarcasm, she harbors a deep tenderness and a developing sense of humor that mellowed her stiff deportment over time. She holds a strong sense of duty, disdains stinginess, and dislikes useless pretense or excess imagination. Despite her restrained emotional expression, she cares fiercely for those she loves and is capable of deep warmth.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v1 c8 P19](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0019), [v1 c8 P41](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0041), [v1 c12 P46](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0046), [v1 c20 P9](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0009), [v1 c30 P3](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0003), [v1 c38 P46](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0046), [v3 c22 P2](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0002)_

## History

Marilla Cuthbert lived her entire life at Green Gables in Avonlea alongside her unmarried brother Matthew. When they intended to adopt a young boy from an asylum to help on the farm, a mistake resulted in the arrival of Anne Shirley. Although initially hesitant, Marilla resolved to keep and raise Anne, gradually coming to love the wild, imaginative child deeply. After Matthew's sudden death from heart failure, Marilla decided to keep Green Gables with Anne's help. Following the death of a distant relative, she took in six-year-old twins, Davy and Dora Keith, taking charge of their upbringing. In her later years, she traveled away from Avonlea for the first time to visit Anne in Four Winds for Christmas and later returned to assist Anne after the birth of her children. Marilla spends her old age at Green Gables enjoying visits from Anne's children, particularly favoring Anne's eldest son, Jem.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P7](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0007), [v1 c6 P3](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0003), [v1 c8 P5](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0005), [v1 c30 P3](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0003), [v1 c37 P1](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0001), [v2 c7 P27](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0027), [v2 c8 P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v4 c15 P1](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0001), [v4 c19 P0](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0000), [v5 c2 P4](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0004), [v5 c3 P6](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0006)_
